name: hello-aflt
goal: From an empty git repo seeded only with instructions and the loop itself (AGENTS.md, SPEC.md, .agentfleet.json, .gitignore, and .agentfleet/ with this loop, its prompts and its two check scripts — no game code, no HTML), build a tile-based dungeon roguelike using aflt loop: M0 is a real agent build of the scaffold from SPEC.md, then M1-M4 gameplay milestones, then an equivalent M5a eval harness, then at most 3 eval-gated improvement rounds that stop at plateau. Zero-dependency Node ESM, HTML canvas, node:test, server on 127.0.0.1 (default PORT 8792; HOST overrides; 8790 and 8791 are commonly taken).
acceptance: M0: the agent writes package.json, server.js, public/index.html, src/main.js, test/smoke.test.js and README.md itself (nothing is copied in); .agentfleet/checks/m0-check.cjs verifies them structurally, runs node --test, and boots the server. M1-M4 and M5a each leave the node:test suite green. M5a adds scripts/eval (bot.js, scorer.js, eval.js) with the original metric names and weights (crash_free 0.25, solvability 0.20, avg_depth 0.20, turns_survived 0.15, balance_sanity 0.20; avg_depth target 3.5) and writes eval/history.jsonl. Then at most 3 improve rounds, stopping when overall plateaus, regresses after revert, reaches >= 99, or hits 3 rounds. Local commits per passed phase are allowed; no remotes, no push.
